subject: DI05019011

h.en: 3.1.1 Need and comparison of machining methods

body.en:
Definition / principle

Non-conventional methods use electrical, chemical, thermal or fluid/abrasive energy instead of relying only on a sharp wedge tool.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Need: hard/brittle/special materials, intricate cavities, microfeatures, low mechanical load or difficult access—not automatic superiority over conventional machining.
  • Conventional cutting commonly forms chips with tool/work contact; non-conventional removal may be erosion, dissolution, melting/vaporisation or combinations.
  • Compare material constraint, accuracy, surface integrity, removal rate, cost, tool wear, environment and geometry; not all methods are force-free or burr-free.
Must every non-conventional process use conductive work?

No. Ordinary ECM/EDM need conductivity; USM can work on suitable nonconductive brittle materials.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Non-conventionalમાં ફક્ત sharp wedgeને બદલે electrical, chemical, thermal, fluid/abrasive energy.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Need hard/brittle/special materials, intricate cavities, microfeatures, low mechanical load, difficult access;હંમેશાં superiority નહિ.
  • Conventionalમાં tool contactથી chips; non-conventionalમાં erosion, dissolution, melting/vaporisation/combinations.
  • Material constraint, accuracy, surface integrity, MRR, cost, wear, environment, geometry compare;બધા force/burr-free નહિ.
દરેક Non-conventional Processમાં Conductive Work જોઈએ?

ના.Ordinary ECM/EDMને conductivity જોઈએ; USM suitable nonconductive brittle material પર કામ કરી શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify by the dominant material-removal mechanism, not merely whether electricity runs the machine.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Mechanical erosion: USM, AJM, WJM/AWJM; electrochemical dissolution: ECM.
  • Thermal/electrical discharge: die-sinking EDM, wire EDM; thermal beam/arc: LBM, PAM.
  • Wire EDM and die sinking share spark erosion but differ in electrode shape, motion and achievable geometry.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Dominant removal mechanismથી classify કરો,ફક્ત motor electricityથી ચાલે છે તે પરથી નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Mechanical erosion USM, AJM, WJM/AWJM; electrochemical dissolution ECM.
  • Thermal/electrical discharge die-sinking EDM, wire EDM; thermal beam/arc LBM, PAM.
  • Wire EDM, die sinking spark erosion share કરે,પણ electrode, motion, geometry જુદી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Controlled anodic dissolution removes electrically conducting work material across an electrolyte-filled gap.

Classification / representative type

  • Electrochemical removal; ECM is not EDM.Work is anode(+), tool cathode(−)in the basic arrangement.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Conducting shaped tool defines the intended opposite surface and is electrically connected as cathode.
  2. Conducting workpiece connects as anode and is securely located.
  3. DC supply/control drives dissolution without intended tool/work short circuit.
  4. Electrolyte circulation, filtration and temperature control maintain gap conditions.
  5. Tool-feed/servo arrangement maintains the working gap as material dissolves.
  6. Enclosure, gas/by-product management and approved waste treatment contain hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Current passes through the electrolyte between tool and work.
  2. Work atoms oxidise into ions at the anode surface.
  3. Cathodic reaction and electrolyte chemistry complete the circuit; gas/by-products require control.
  4. Flow removes reaction products and heat from the gap.
  5. Tool advances under gap control so the intended surface is progressively reproduced with required allowance.
  6. Inspection verifies geometry/overcut/surface; cleaning and waste handling follow approved industrial procedures.

Working parameters / controls

  • Current density/charge controls removal rate for a given electrochemical equivalent.
  • Gap, voltage, electrolyte conductivity/temperature and flow affect localisation, overcut and stability.
  • Feed must balance dissolution; too small a gap risks short circuit, too large loses definition.

Applications / advantages

Complex cavities/deburring of conductive alloys with low mechanical cutting force; hardness is less decisive than conductivity/chemistry.

Limitations / safety

Cannot machine ordinary nonconductors; stray dissolution, corrosion, energy and electrolyte/gas/waste hazards matter. No electrolyte recipe or live setup is supplied.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Electrolyte gapમાં controlled anodic dissolutionથી conductive work material દૂર થાય.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Electrochemical removal; ECM, EDM નહિ.Basicમાં work anode(+), tool cathode(−).

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. ઇચ્છિત સપાટીને અનુરૂપ આકારવાળું વિદ્યુતવાહક tool લગાડાય છે. તેને cathode બનાવવાથી સામેના workમાંથી material દૂર થઈ શકે છે.
  2. વિદ્યુતવાહક workpieceને anode સાથે જોડીને મજબૂત રીતે locate કરાય છે,જેથી machining દરમિયાન datum બદલાય નહિ.
  3. DC supply અને control દ્વારા dissolution માટે current અપાય છે. Tool અને work સીધાં અડીને short circuit કરે તે ઇચ્છિત સ્થિતિ નથી.
  4. Electrolyte circulation સાથે filtration અને temperature control રાખવાથી working gapમાં યોગ્ય પ્રવાહ તથા સ્થિતિ જળવાય છે.
  5. Material ઓગળીને દૂર થાય તેમ tool-feed/servo આગળ વધે છે અને જરૂરી working gap જાળવે છે.
  6. Enclosure,gas/by-product management અને મંજૂર waste treatment દ્વારા chemical તથા process hazards કાબૂમાં રાખવામાં આવે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Tool અને work વચ્ચે રહેલા electrolyteમાંથી current પસાર થાય છે અને electrochemical circuit બને છે.
  2. Anode બનેલી workની સપાટી પર atomsનું oxidation થાય છે;તે ionsમાં ફેરવાઈ workમાંથી દૂર થાય છે.
  3. Cathode પરની reaction અને electrolyteની chemistry circuit પૂર્ણ કરે છે. બનતા gas તથા by-productsને નિયંત્રિત કરવા જરૂરી છે.
  4. Electrolyteનો સતત પ્રવાહ gapમાંથી reaction products અને heat બહાર લઈ જાય છે,જેથી આગળનું dissolution સ્થિર રહે.
  5. Gap control મુજબ tool આગળ વધતાં તેની સામેની ઇચ્છિત સપાટી required allowance સાથે ધીમે ધીમે workમાં ઉતરે છે.
  6. Geometry,overcut અને surfaceની તપાસ થાય છે. Cleaning તથા waste handling માત્ર મંજૂર industrial procedures મુજબ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Current density/charge removal rate control.
  • Gap, voltage, conductivity/temp, flow localisation, overcut, stability બદલે.
  • Feed dissolution સાથે balance; small gap short, large gap definition loss.

Applications / લાભ

Conductive alloysની cavities/deburring, low mechanical force; hardness કરતાં conductivity/chemistry મહત્વનાં.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Ordinary nonconductors નહિ; stray dissolution, corrosion, energy, chemical/gas/waste hazards; recipe/live setup નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Repeated controlled sparks melt/vaporise tiny regions of conducting work and flushing removes debris.

Classification / representative type

  • Thermal electrical-discharge erosion; shaped-electrode die sinking differs from travelling-wire EDM.Polarity depends on process/tool conditions.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Shaped conductive electrode, commonly suitable copper/graphite, corresponds to the cavity with gap/wear allowances.
  2. Conductive workpiece and holder define position and current path.
  3. Pulsed power supply controls discharge energy and timing.
  4. Servo feed adjusts electrode position to maintain a spark gap.
  5. Dielectric tank/nozzles and filtration cool, insulate between pulses and flush debris.
  6. Enclosure, fire protection and monitoring address dielectric/discharge hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Electrode approaches without intended mechanical contact.
  2. A pulse builds field until local dielectric breakdown forms a discharge channel.
  3. Concentrated heat produces a small crater by melting/vaporisation.
  4. Pulse off-time allows channel collapse, deionisation and debris removal.
  5. Repeated discharges and servo motion develop the cavity; tool wear changes the reproduced geometry.
  6. Finish passes/inspection assess size, roughness, recast layer and any cracking according to requirements.

Working parameters / controls

  • Peak current, pulse-on/off times and gap control influence MRR, finish and tool wear.
  • Higher discharge energy often increases removal/crater size; flushing and stable pulses are essential.

Applications / advantages

Blind cavities, die/mould work and hard conductive components.

Limitations / safety

Conductive work required; electrode wear, recast/HAZ, possible microcracks and relatively slow finishing. No live electrical/dielectric instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Controlled sparks conductive workનાં tiny regions melt/vaporise કરે, flushing debris દૂર કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Thermal discharge erosion; shaped-electrode sinking, travelling-wireથી જુદું.Polarity process મુજબ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Cavityને અનુરૂપ shaped conductive electrode વપરાય છે;યોગ્ય copper/graphite ઉદાહરણ છે. તેમાં spark gap અને tool wear માટે allowance રાખવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Conductive workpiece અને તેનો holder workનું સ્થાન તથા currentનો માર્ગ નક્કી કરે છે.
  3. Pulsed power supply દરેક dischargeની energy અને on/off timing નિયંત્રિત કરે છે,જેથી material removal કાબૂમાં રહે.
  4. Servo feed electrodeનું સ્થાન સુધારી જરૂરી spark gap જાળવે છે;toolને work પર દબાવીને cutting થતું નથી.
  5. Dielectric tank/nozzles અને filtration ઠંડક આપે છે,બે pulses વચ્ચે insulation પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરે છે અને debris બહાર કાઢે છે.
  6. Enclosure,fire protection અને monitoring દ્વારા dielectric તથા electrical-discharge સંબંધિત hazards સંભાળાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Electrode workની નજીક આવે છે,પણ ઇચ્છિત પ્રક્રિયામાં mechanical contact થતો નથી;નાનો નિયંત્રિત gap રહે છે.
  2. Pulseથી electric field વધતાં ચોક્કસ સ્થળે dielectric breakdown થાય છે અને discharge channel બને છે.
  3. સ્થાનિક concentrated heatથી materialનો નાનો ભાગ melt/vaporise થાય છે અને સપાટી પર નાનું crater બને છે.
  4. Pulseના off-timeમાં channel તૂટે છે,deionisation થાય છે અને debris દૂર થાય છે;આગળનો pulse સ્થિર રહેવામાં આ મદદ કરે છે.
  5. વારંવાર થતા discharges અને servo motionથી cavity બને છે. Electrode wear થતાં ઉતરતી geometry પણ બદલાઈ શકે છે.
  6. જરૂરી finish passes પછી size,roughness,recast layer અને શક્ય crackingની specification મુજબ તપાસ કરવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Peak current, on/off, gap MRR, finish, wear બદલે.
  • Higher energy સામાન્ય removal/crater size વધારે; flushing, stable pulses જરૂરી.

Applications / લાભ

Blind cavities, die/mould, hard conductive parts.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Conductive work જરૂરી; wear, recast/HAZ, microcracks, slow finishing; live instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A continuously fed thin wire electrode follows a controlled contour by spark erosion through conductive work.

Classification / representative type

  • Thermal EDM with travelling wire; suited to through profiles, not ordinary blind cavities.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Wire reel, feed and take-up supply fresh electrode through the cutting zone.
  2. Upper/lower guides establish wire position and tension.
  3. Conductive workholder and controlled axes generate the contour.
  4. Pulse generator supplies controlled discharge energy across the gap.
  5. Dielectric/flushing, commonly controlled deionised-water systems, remove heat/debris.
  6. Computer control handles path, offset, corner behaviour and suitable taper axes.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Wire enters from an accessible edge or a suitable start hole for an enclosed contour.
  2. Guides and tension maintain the intended wire line.
  3. Sparks remove work on both sides, so kerf exceeds bare wire diameter by spark gaps.
  4. Coordinated axis motion follows the programmed offset contour while wire continually renews.
  5. Flushing and pulse controls stabilise cut; additional trim passes can improve finish/accuracy.
  6. Removed section and remaining profile are safely handled/inspected; slugs must not destabilise the cut.

Working parameters / controls

  • Current, pulse timing, wire speed/tension, flushing, axis feed and offset affect stability, kerf and finish.
  • Work thickness, wire lag and corner conditions affect dimensional result; no universal accuracy is promised.

Applications / advantages

Punches, dies, precision through contours and suitable taper profiles in conductive stock.

Limitations / safety

Cannot make a closed internal profile without wire access; conductivity, recast layer, wire breakage and cost constrain selection.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Continuously fed thin wire conductive workમાં spark erosionથી contour follow કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Travelling-wire thermal EDM; through profiles માટે, ordinary blind cavities નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Wire reel,feed અને take-up દ્વારા cutting zoneમાં સતત નવો wire electrode પહોંચાડાય છે;એક જ wireનો સ્થિર tool તરીકે ઉપયોગ થતો નથી.
  2. Upper/lower guides wireનું સ્થાન નક્કી કરે છે અને tension તેને ઇચ્છિત સીધી lineમાં રાખે છે.
  3. Conductive workholder અને controlled axes work તથા wireની relative position બદલી ઇચ્છિત contour બનાવે છે.
  4. Pulse generator wire અને workના gapમાં નિયંત્રિત discharge energy પૂરી પાડે છે.
  5. Dielectric તથા flushing heat અને debris દૂર કરે છે;ઘણી machinesમાં નિયંત્રિત deionised-water system વપરાય છે.
  6. Computer control path,offset,corner behaviour અને ઉપલબ્ધ taper axes સંભાળે છે,જેથી contour યોગ્ય રીતે ઉતરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Wire accessible edgeથી પ્રવેશે છે;બંધ contour માટે યોગ્ય start hole જોઈએ,જેથી wireને through path મળી શકે.
  2. Guides અને tension cutting દરમિયાન wireને ઇચ્છિત lineમાં રાખે છે અને અનિયંત્રિત વળાંક ઘટાડે છે.
  3. Wireની બંને બાજુ sparks work દૂર કરે છે. તેથી kerf ફક્ત wire diameter જેટલો નહિ,પણ બંને spark gaps સહિત મોટો બને છે.
  4. Axes programmed offset contour પ્રમાણે relative motion આપે છે અને wire સતત આગળ વધી renew થતો રહે છે.
  5. Flushing અને pulse control cutને સ્થિર રાખે છે. જરૂર મુજબ વધારાના trim passesથી finish અને accuracy સુધારી શકાય છે.
  6. Cut-out section અને remaining profileને સુરક્ષિત રીતે સંભાળી તપાસ થાય છે;ઢીલો slug cutને અસ્થિર ન બનાવે તે જરૂરી છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Current, pulses, wire speed/tension, flushing, feed, offset stability/kerf/finish બદલે.
  • Thickness, wire lag, corners result બદલે; universal accuracy નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Conductive stockમાં punches, dies, precision through/taper profiles.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Wire access વગર closed internal profile નહિ; conductivity, recast, wire breakage, cost limits.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A vibrating shaped tool drives abrasive particles to microchip/erode work, particularly hard brittle materials.

Classification / representative type

  • Mechanical abrasive impact; traditional slurry USM differs from rotary ultrasonic assistance. Conductivity is not a basic requirement.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Generator supplies high-frequency electrical input.
  2. Transducer converts electrical input to mechanical vibration.
  3. Horn/booster transmits/amplifies vibration to tool.
  4. Tough shaped tool defines approximate cavity with abrasive overcut allowance.
  5. Abrasive slurry delivery/collection supplies suitable grains and removes debris.
  6. Feed/work support controls static load, gap and alignment.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Tool vibrates towards/away from work under controlled feed.
  2. Abrasive grains enter the tool/work gap.
  3. Impacts load small work regions and induce brittle fracture/microchipping where suitable.
  4. Fresh slurry replenishes grains and removes fragments.
  5. Tool feed follows material removal and transfers its approximate shape.
  6. Part/tool wear, overcut and surface damage are inspected after the cycle.

Working parameters / controls

  • Vibration frequency/amplitude, static feed force, abrasive size/type/concentration and slurry flow influence MRR and finish.
  • Tool wear and access limit fidelity; larger grains may improve removal but worsen finish under otherwise similar conditions.

Applications / advantages

Holes/cavities in glass, ceramics and suitable brittle hard materials.

Limitations / safety

Slow/deep-cavity limitations, tool wear and poor efficiency in very ductile stock; slurry and vibration require approved containment.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Vibrating shaped tool abrasivesથી work microchip/erode કરે,ખાસ hard brittle.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Mechanical abrasive impact; traditional slurry USM, rotary assistanceથી જુદું; conductivity જરૂરી નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Generator high-frequency electrical input પૂરું પાડે છે;આ input પોતે સીધું workને sparkથી કાપતું નથી.
  2. Transducer electrical inputને mechanical vibrationમાં ફેરવે છે,જેથી tool oscillate કરી શકે.
  3. Horn/booster vibrationને tool સુધી પહોંચાડે છે અને design મુજબ તેની amplitude વધારી શકે છે.
  4. Tough shaped tool approximate cavity નક્કી કરે છે;abrasiveના કારણે થતા overcut માટે allowance જોઈએ.
  5. Abrasive slurry delivery/collection gapમાં યોગ્ય grains પહોંચાડે છે અને removal પછીનો debris બહાર લઈ જાય છે.
  6. Feed અને work support static load,gap તથા alignment નિયંત્રિત કરે છે,જેથી vibration અસરકારક રીતે કામ કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Controlled feed સાથે tool work તરફ અને તેનાથી દૂર વારંવાર vibrate થાય છે.
  2. Slurryમાં રહેલા abrasive grains tool અને work વચ્ચેના gapમાં પ્રવેશે છે.
  3. Vibrating tool grains મારફતે નાના વિસ્તારો પર impact આપે છે;યોગ્ય brittle materialમાં fracture/microchippingથી removal થાય છે.
  4. Fresh slurry નવા grains પહોંચાડે છે અને તૂટેલા fragments દૂર કરે છે,જેથી gapમાં debris એકઠો ન થાય.
  5. Material દૂર થાય તેમ tool feed આગળ વધે છે અને toolનો approximate આકાર workમાં ઉતરે છે.
  6. Cycle પછી part/tool wear,overcut અને surface damage તપાસાય છે;tool shape જેટલી જ exact cavity માની લેવાતી નથી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Frequency/amplitude, static force, abrasive size/type/concentration, flow MRR/finish બદલે.
  • Wear/access fidelity limit; larger grains સામાન્ય removal વધારે, finish બગાડી શકે.

Applications / લાભ

Glass, ceramics, suitable brittle hard materialsનાં holes/cavities.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Slow/deep limits, tool wear, ductile stockમાં low efficiency; approved containment.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Focused optical energy causes local thermal removal according to absorption and pulse/scan conditions.

Classification / representative type

  • Thermal beam process; pulsed/continuous and drilling/cutting/ablation modes differ.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Laser source and power controls generate the required beam.
  2. Beam delivery mirrors/fibre and focusing optics concentrate energy.
  3. Focus-position/control system relates spot to work surface.
  4. Work stage/scanner supplies relative path or stationary drilling location.
  5. Assist-gas arrangement where required removes melt/protects the process.
  6. Interlocked enclosure, extraction and appropriate optical protection control invisible-beam/fume hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Beam is focused at the intended region.
  2. Absorbed energy raises local temperature rapidly.
  3. Melting, vaporisation or ablation removes material depending on pulse/material conditions.
  4. Gas/recoil/ejection mechanisms clear the interaction region where applicable.
  5. Pulse sequence or scanning motion develops the hole/kerf/profile.
  6. Inspection checks taper, recast/HAZ, edge quality and dimensional result.

Working parameters / controls

  • Power/energy, pulse duration/repetition, wavelength, spot size, focus, scan speed and gas influence fluence and heat input.
  • Absorptivity/reflectivity, thermal conductivity and thickness affect selection; electrical conductivity is not mandatory.

Applications / advantages

Microholes, thin-sheet profiles, marking/ablation and suitable hard-to-machine materials.

Limitations / safety

HAZ, recast, reflective materials, focus/thickness limits and severe optical/fume hazards; no open-beam operation instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Focused optical energy absorption, pulse/scan મુજબ local thermal removal કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Thermal beam; pulsed/continuous, drilling/cutting/ablation modes જુદા.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Laser source અને power controls જરૂરી beam બનાવે છે અને તેની energy delivery નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  2. Beam-delivery mirrors/fibre તથા focusing optics energyને નાનાં વિસ્તારમાં concentrate કરે છે.
  3. Focus-position/control system work surface સામે spotનું સ્થાન નક્કી કરે છે,કારણ કે focus બદલાતાં energy density બદલાય છે.
  4. Work stage/scanner relative path આપે છે;stationary drillingમાં ઇચ્છિત સ્થાન જાળવે છે.
  5. જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં assist gas melt દૂર કરવામાં અથવા processને protect કરવામાં મદદ કરે છે.
  6. Interlocked enclosure,extraction તથા યોગ્ય optical protection invisible beam અને fumesના hazards નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Beamને workના ઇચ્છિત વિસ્તારમાં focus કરવામાં આવે છે,જેથી energy મુખ્યત્વે તે જ વિસ્તારમાં મળે.
  2. Work દ્વારા absorbed energy સ્થાનિક temperature ઝડપથી વધારે છે;absorption material પર આધારિત છે.
  3. Pulse તથા material conditions પ્રમાણે melting,vaporisation અથવા ablationથી material દૂર થાય છે.
  4. જ્યાં લાગુ પડે ત્યાં gas,recoil અથવા ejection mechanisms interaction regionમાંથી દૂર થયેલું material બહાર કાઢે છે.
  5. Pulse sequence અથવા scanning motion વારંવાર removal કરીને hole,kerf અથવા profile વિકસાવે છે.
  6. અંતે taper,recast/HAZ,edge quality અને dimensions તપાસાય છે;beamથી કાપાયું એટલે damage-free હોવાનું નથી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Power/energy, pulses, wavelength, spot, focus, scan, gas fluence/heat બદલે.
  • Absorptivity/reflectivity, thermal conductivity, thickness અસર; electrical conductivity mandatory નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Microholes, thin-sheet profiles, marking/ablation, suitable materials.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

HAZ, recast, reflection, focus/thickness limits, optical/fume hazards; open-beam instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Fine abrasives accelerated by a gas jet erode a local work surface.

Classification / representative type

  • Mechanical erosion; AJM gas carrier is not pure-water WJM or abrasive-water AWJM.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Compressed-gas supply and conditioning provide clean dry carrier flow.
  2. Abrasive feeder meters fine particles.
  3. Mixing chamber combines gas and abrasive.
  4. Wear-resistant nozzle directs and accelerates the stream.
  5. Work support/mask defines exposed areas where used.
  6. Enclosure, extraction and collection manage dust and spent media.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Conditioned gas reaches the mixing stage.
  2. Metered particles enter carrier stream.
  3. Nozzle accelerates particles towards the work.
  4. Impacts remove small fragments by erosion, depending on angle/material.
  5. Controlled exposure/motion develops the required feature.
  6. Spent media and dust are captured; feature size/edge condition are inspected.

Working parameters / controls

  • Gas pressure/flow, abrasive size/type/feed, nozzle size, stand-off distance and impact angle affect erosion footprint.
  • Nozzle wear and excessive stand-off broaden the jet and alter accuracy.

Applications / advantages

Deburring, etching/cleaning and fine work on suitable brittle materials.

Limitations / safety

Low MRR, dust, embedded abrasives, nozzle wear and limited deep access; no compressed-gas/dust exposure recipe.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Gas jetથી accelerated fine abrasives local surface erode કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Mechanical erosion; gas AJM, pure-water WJM/AWJM નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Compressed-gas supply અને conditioning clean,dry carrier flow આપે છે,જેથી particle delivery સ્થિર રહે.
  2. Abrasive feeder fine particlesની માત્રા નિયંત્રિત રીતે આપે છે;અનિયંત્રિત feedથી removal બદલાઈ શકે છે.
  3. Mixing chamber gas અને abrasiveને ભેળવી particle-carrying stream બનાવે છે.
  4. Wear-resistant nozzle streamને work તરફ દિશા આપે છે અને particlesને ઝડપી બનાવે છે.
  5. Work support workને સ્થિર રાખે છે;જ્યાં mask વપરાય ત્યાં કયો વિસ્તાર exposed રહે તે mask નક્કી કરે છે.
  6. Enclosure,extraction અને collection દ્વારા dust તથા spent media કાબૂમાં રાખવામાં આવે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Conditioned gas mixing stage સુધી પહોંચે છે,જ્યાં આગળ particle stream તૈયાર થાય છે.
  2. Metered abrasive particles gas carrierમાં ઉમેરાય છે,જેથી delivery નિયંત્રિત રહે.
  3. Nozzle particlesને accelerate કરીને work તરફ દોરી જાય છે;આ gas-borne abrasive process છે.
  4. Particle impactથી નાના fragments erosion દ્વારા છૂટે છે. Impact angle અને work material removalને અસર કરે છે.
  5. Controlled exposure અથવા relative motionથી જરૂરી feature ધીમે ધીમે બને છે.
  6. Spent abrasive અને dust capture કરાય છે;પછી feature size તથા edge condition તપાસવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Gas pressure/flow, abrasive size/type/feed, nozzle, stand-off, angle footprint બદલે.
  • Nozzle wear, excess stand-off jet ફેલાવે, accuracy બદલે.

Applications / લાભ

Deburring, etching/cleaning, suitable brittle fine work.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Low MRR, dust, embedded abrasive, wear, deep access limits; exposure recipe નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A high-temperature ionised gas jet melts material and expels it in suitable cutting operations.

Classification / representative type

  • Thermal arc: transferred arc closes through conductive work; non-transferred jet uses an internal torch circuit and has different capability.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Power supply provides controlled arc energy.
  2. Torch contains electrode and constricting nozzle.
  3. Gas supply/control establishes plasma and any shielding duty.
  4. Torch cooling protects components from heat.
  5. Work connection/table and controlled travel suit the selected transferred-arc application.
  6. Extraction, screening and interlocks address fumes, radiation, noise and electric hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Approved initiation establishes the intended arc within the controlled system.
  2. Gas passing the constricted arc region becomes an energetic ionised jet.
  3. In transferred cutting, the work completes the electrical path.
  4. Concentrated thermal input melts a narrow region.
  5. Jet motion expels melt as torch travel develops a kerf.
  6. Edge bevel, dross, HAZ and dimensions are inspected.

Working parameters / controls

  • Current, gas composition/flow, nozzle condition, stand-off and traverse speed influence kerf, dross and heat effects.
  • Thickness and conductivity constrain the common transferred-cutting route.

Applications / advantages

Productive profile cutting of suitable electrically conductive metal plate.

Limitations / safety

HAZ, dross, noise, UV/electrical hazards and lower fine-detail capability than some precision alternatives; no torch-start/setup instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

High-temperature ionised gas jet suitable cuttingમાં material melt, expel કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Thermal arc: transferred workમાંથી circuit; non-transferred internal torch circuit, capability જુદી.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Power supply arcને નિયંત્રિત energy આપે છે,જેથી thermal removal માટે જરૂરી input મળે.
  2. Torchમાં electrode અને constricting nozzle હોય છે;nozzle arc/plasmaને concentrated regionમાં રાખે છે.
  3. Gas supply/control plasma બનાવવાનો પ્રવાહ આપે છે અને arrangement મુજબ shielding પણ આપે છે.
  4. Torch cooling componentsને excessive heatથી બચાવે છે;તે cutting energyનો substitute નથી.
  5. Work connection,table અને controlled travel પસંદ કરેલી transferred-arc application માટે યોગ્ય રીતે ગોઠવાય છે.
  6. Extraction,screening અને interlocks fumes,radiation,noise તથા electric hazards સંભાળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. મંજૂર controlled systemની અંદર approved initiation દ્વારા ઇચ્છિત arc સ્થાપિત થાય છે;અહીં live starting procedure આપવામાં આવતી નથી.
  2. Gas constricted arc regionમાંથી પસાર થતાં ઊર્જાવાળો ionised plasma jet બને છે.
  3. Transferred cuttingમાં conductive work electrical path પૂર્ણ કરે છે;આથી material conductivity જરૂરી બને છે.
  4. Concentrated thermal input workના સાંકડા વિસ્તારમાં material melt કરે છે.
  5. Jetનો પ્રવાહ melt બહાર કાઢે છે અને torch travel સાથે kerf આગળ વધે છે.
  6. અંતે edge bevel,dross,HAZ અને dimensions તપાસાય છે,કારણ કે thermal cutમાં આ deviations રહી શકે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Current, gas/flow, nozzle, stand-off, traverse kerf, dross, heat બદલે.
  • Thickness, conductivity common transferred routeને limit કરે.

Applications / લાભ

Suitable conductive metal plateનું productive profile cutting.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

HAZ, dross, noise, UV/electrical hazards, fine-detail limits; torch-start/setup instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

High-velocity water removes/separates suitable material; abrasive-water cutting adds a distinct abrasive erosion contribution.

Classification / representative type

  • Pure WJM versus AWJM: plain water commonly suits softer nonmetals; abrasive addition extends capability to many metals/hard materials.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Water treatment/supply supports required fluid quality.
  2. Engineered high-pressure pump/intensifier supplies jet energy.
  3. Rated lines, valves and orifice contain/direct high-pressure flow.
  4. Nozzle/work-motion system defines cutting path and stand-off.
  5. AWJM additionally has abrasive metering, mixing/focusing tube; these are absent in pure WJM.
  6. Catcher, enclosure, interlocks and waste collection dissipate jet energy safely.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Pump transfers energy to a controlled water stream.
  2. Orifice converts pressure energy into a high-speed jet.
  3. Pure water impacts and separates suitable soft material.
  4. In AWJM, entrained abrasive accelerates and erodes harder work.
  5. Controlled traverse develops kerf; lag and taper depend on conditions.
  6. Catcher absorbs remaining energy and inspection checks edge, delamination/taper and dimensions.

Working parameters / controls

  • Pressure/flow, orifice/focusing size, stand-off, traverse and thickness affect penetration and taper.
  • AWJM abrasive type/feed and mixing-tube wear additionally matter; no universal pressure or speed is supplied.

Applications / advantages

Cold-cutting suitable soft nonmetals by water; AWJM expands to many hard materials with little thermal HAZ.

Limitations / safety

Jet can penetrate tissue; pressure, noise, water sensitivity, delamination, taper and abrasive waste require controls. No DIY pressure-system instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

High-velocity water suitable material remove/separate કરે; abrasive-waterમાં અલગ abrasive contribution.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Pure WJM/AWJM: plain water સામાન્ય softer nonmetals; abrasiveથી metals/hard materials સુધી capability.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Water treatment/supply યોગ્ય fluid quality આપે છે,જેથી pump/orifice systemને ઇચ્છિત feed મળે.
  2. Engineered high-pressure pump/intensifier પાણીમાં jet બનાવવા જરૂરી energy ઉમેરે છે.
  3. યોગ્ય pressure ratingવાળી lines,valves અને orifice high-pressure flowને contain કરીને દિશા આપે છે.
  4. Nozzle તથા work-motion system cutting path અને stand-off નક્કી કરે છે.
  5. AWJMમાં abrasive metering,mixing તથા focusing tube વધારામાં હોય છે;pure WJMમાં આ abrasive system હોતું નથી.
  6. Catcher,enclosure,interlocks અને waste collection બાકી jet energy સુરક્ષિત રીતે શોષી hazards નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Pump નિયંત્રિત water streamને pressure energy આપે છે,જે આગળ nozzle સુધી પહોંચે છે.
  2. Orifice આ pressure energyને high-speed jetમાં ફેરવે છે;high pressure પોતે સીધું tool contact નથી.
  3. Pure water jet યોગ્ય soft material પર impact કરીને તેને અલગ/કાપી શકે છે;દરેક hard material માટે આ ક્ષમતા માની ન શકાય.
  4. AWJMમાં ભેળવાયેલા abrasive particles accelerate થાય છે અને harder workને erosion દ્વારા દૂર કરે છે.
  5. Controlled traverseથી kerf બને છે. Jet lag અને taper actual conditions પર આધારિત હોય છે.
  6. Catcher બાકી energy શોષે છે. Inspectionમાં edge,delamination/taper અને dimensions તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Pressure/flow, orifice/focusing size, stand-off, traverse, thickness penetration/taper બદલે.
  • AWJM abrasive/feed, mixing wear extra; universal pressure/speed નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Waterથી suitable soft nonmetals; AWJM hard materials,ઓછો thermal HAZ.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Jet tissue penetrate કરી શકે; pressure, noise, water sensitivity, delamination, taper, waste controls; DIY instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

First reject physically unsuitable methods; then compare productivity, quality and lifecycle cost.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Nonconductive glass: ordinary EDM/ECM are unsuitable; USM or suitable laser/jet routes may fit depending on geometry/finish.
  • Conductive hard blind cavity: die-sinking EDM can fit; ordinary wire EDM needs through-access and is not a blind-cavity substitute.
  • Thermal-damage-sensitive edge: consider mechanical/chemical routes, but check forces, chemistry, water sensitivity and accuracy.
  • Compare MRR, feature size, aspect ratio, overcut, tool wear, recast, residual effects, consumables, energy, waste and inspection.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

પહેલાં physically unsuitable methods reject;પછી productivity, quality, lifecycle cost.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Nonconductive glass માટે ordinary EDM/ECM નહિ; geometry/finish મુજબ USM/laser/jet.
  • Conductive hard blind cavityમાં die-sinking EDM; wireને through-access જોઈએ.
  • Thermal-sensitive edgeમાં mechanical/chemical,પણ forces, chemistry, water sensitivity, accuracy check.
  • MRR, size, aspect ratio, overcut, wear, recast, residual effects, consumables, energy, waste, inspection compare.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Micro-electro-mechanical systems integrate microscale mechanical functions with sensing/actuation and often electronics.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Elements may include microbeams, membranes, cavities, electrodes and readout circuitry; not every MEMS is a complete moving machine.
  • Small mass enables sensitive/fast response, but surface forces, stiction, contamination and packaging can dominate.
  • Batch fabrication supports repeatability/integration; microscale does not automatically guarantee cheap development or robust packaging.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

MEMS microscale mechanical functionsને sensing/actuation,ઘણી વાર electronics સાથે જોડે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Microbeams, membranes, cavities, electrodes, readout હોઈ શકે;દરેક complete moving machine નહિ.
  • Small mass sensitive/fast response આપે,પણ surface forces, stiction, contamination, packaging dominate.
  • Batch fabrication repeatability/integration; microscale એટલે cheap development/robust packaging guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Material choice follows structural, electrical, chemical, thermal and processing needs.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Silicon/silicon-based layers: structural and electronic compatibility; single-crystal/polycrystalline behaviour differs.
  • Oxides/nitrides: insulation, masking or sacrificial roles according to the stack; not every layer is structural.
  • Metals: conductors/electrodes; polymers: compliant structures, microfluidics or packaging; glass: optical/insulating substrates.
  • Check residual stress, adhesion, thermal expansion, biocompatibility where required and compatibility with later etch/deposition steps.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Structural, electrical, chemical, thermal, processing needsથી selection.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Silicon-based layers structural/electronic compatibility; single/polycrystal behaviour જુદું.
  • Oxides/nitrides insulation, masking/sacrificial roles;દરેક structural નહિ.
  • Metals conductors/electrodes; polymers compliant/microfluidic/packaging; glass optical/insulating.
  • Residual stress, adhesion, thermal expansion, required biocompatibility, later steps compatibility check.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Lithography creates a resist pattern defining where later etching, deposition or other processing acts; exposure alone does not necessarily cut the substrate.

Classification / representative type

  • By pattern delivery: mask-based optical exposure or suitable direct-write routes. By resist response: positive versus negative; these are different classification bases.
  • Positive resist becomes more soluble in its appropriate developer where exposed; negative resist commonly retains exposed regions through chemistry-dependent change.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Substrate holder supports and positions the clean wafer without losing alignment.
  2. Resist-coating equipment creates a controlled photosensitive film rather than a structural metal layer.
  3. Resist material provides the exposure-dependent change used to distinguish patterned regions.
  4. Mask or direct-write pattern contains the desired feature information.
  5. Alignment/exposure optics register features and deliver controlled exposure.
  6. Development, inspection and protected handling facilities reveal and verify the resist pattern.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Validate substrate cleanliness and previous-layer references before coating.
  2. Apply resist with controlled uniformity and condition it by the approved process.
  3. Align mask/pattern to the required previous features; misregistration propagates through later layers.
  4. Expose selected regions so the resist response changes according to its positive/negative chemistry.
  5. Develop with the appropriate approved process to remove the intended resist regions.
  6. Inspect dimensions, defects and overlay before transferring the pattern by the next fabrication step.

Working parameters / controls

  • Resolution, overlay, exposure dose, resist thickness and cleanliness affect feature size and alignment.
  • No universal exposure or chemical recipe applies to all resists; use qualified cleanroom procedures.

Applications / advantages

Defines patterns for microelectrodes, etch masks and subsequent layers; supports repeated fine features.

Limitations / safety

Resolution, mask/alignment cost, defects and chemical/optical hazards limit the process; no home microfabrication instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Lithography resistનો pattern બનાવે છે,જે later etching/deposition ક્યાં થાય તે નક્કી કરે છે; exposure પોતે substrate કાપતું જરૂરી નથી.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Pattern delivery મુજબ mask-based optical/direct-write; resist response મુજબ positive/negative.આ classificationના જુદા bases છે.
  • Positive resistનો exposed ભાગ suitable developerમાં વધુ soluble થાય છે; negativeમાં chemistry પ્રમાણે exposed ભાગ સામાન્ય રીતે retained રહે છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Substrate holder clean waferને support કરીને alignment માટે યોગ્ય positionમાં રાખે છે.
  2. Resist-coating equipment controlled photosensitive film બનાવે છે;આ structural metal layer નથી.
  3. Resistમાં exposureથી બદલાતો response હોય છે,જે patterned regionsને અલગ પાડવામાં ઉપયોગી બને છે.
  4. Mask અથવા direct-write patternમાં desired featuresની માહિતી હોય છે.
  5. Alignment/exposure optics featuresને register કરે છે અને controlled exposure પહોંચાડે છે.
  6. Development, inspection તથા protected handling facilities resist patternને reveal કરીને verify કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Coating પહેલાં substrateની cleanliness અને previous-layer references યોગ્ય છે તે તપાસાય છે.
  2. Resistને controlled uniformity સાથે apply કરીને approved process મુજબ condition કરાય છે.
  3. Mask/patternને previous features સામે align કરાય છે; misregistrationની ભૂલ આગળનાં layersમાં પણ જાય છે.
  4. Selected regions expose થાય છે અને positive/negative chemistry મુજબ resistનો response બદલાય છે.
  5. Appropriate approved developmentથી intended resist regions દૂર થાય છે અને pattern ખુલ્લો પડે છે.
  6. આગળના fabrication stepથી transfer કરતાં પહેલાં patternનાં dimensions, defects અને overlay તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Resolution, overlay, exposure dose, resist thickness, cleanliness feature size/alignmentને અસર કરે છે.
  • બધા resists માટે એક exposure/chemical recipe નથી; qualified cleanroom procedures જરૂરી છે.

Applications / લાભ

Microelectrodes, etch masks તથા later layers માટે patterns; fine features repeat કરવામાં મદદ.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Resolution, cost, defects, chemical/optical hazards મર્યાદા છે; home processing instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Etching removes exposed material selectively to transfer patterns or release microstructures.

Classification / representative type

  • Process medium: wet chemical versus dry/plasma. Directionality: isotropic versus anisotropic; wet/dry is not the same classification as isotropic/anisotropic.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Patterned wafer and compatible mask define protected versus exposed regions.
  2. Bath or reaction chamber contains the selected wet or dry process environment.
  3. Reactant/gas delivery provides controlled species transport appropriate to the method.
  4. Thermal, chemical or plasma-energy controls maintain the chosen reaction conditions.
  5. Product removal, extraction and protected handling prevent accumulation and contain hazards.
  6. Endpoint monitoring and metrology assess depth, profile and mask survival.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Check the patterned wafer, mask compatibility and required exposed regions.
  2. Establish the approved controlled environment without exposing unintended areas.
  3. Reactants reach exposed material and initiate the appropriate removal reaction or plasma-assisted mechanism.
  4. Products leave the surface so removal continues; transport limits can change uniformity.
  5. Control time/endpoint and directionality to obtain required depth/profile while preserving the mask.
  6. Complete the approved stop/handling sequence and inspect pattern or release; fragile structures may suffer stiction/damage.

Working parameters / controls

  • Etch rate, selectivity, uniformity, directionality, mask survival and endpoint determine useful geometry.
  • Undercut changes lateral dimensions; wet etching is not always isotropic and dry is not always perfectly directional.

Applications / advantages

Cavities, channels, membranes and microstructure release; selective removal enables functional shapes.

Limitations / safety

Aggressive chemicals/plasma, mask loss, damage, stiction and compatibility limits; no etchant or plasma-setting recipe.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Etching exposed materialને selectively દૂર કરીને pattern transfer અથવા microstructure release કરે છે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Medium મુજબ wet chemical/dry-plasma; directionality મુજબ isotropic/anisotropic.આ બન્ને classification સમાન નથી.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Patterned wafer અને compatible mask કયા regions protected/exposed રહેશે તે નક્કી કરે છે.
  2. Bath અથવા reaction chamber selected wet/dry processનું environment contain કરે છે.
  3. Method મુજબ reactant/gas deliveryથી controlled species transport મળે છે.
  4. Thermal, chemical અથવા plasma-energy controls chosen reaction conditions જાળવે છે.
  5. Product removal, extraction તથા protected handling accumulation અટકાવે છે અને hazards contain કરે છે.
  6. Endpoint monitoring અને metrology depth, profile તથા mask survival તપાસે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Patterned wafer, mask compatibility અને required exposed regions પહેલાં તપાસાય છે.
  2. Unintended areasને exposure આપ્યા વગર approved controlled environment સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  3. Reactants exposed material સુધી પહોંચે છે અને required reaction/plasma-assisted removal શરૂ કરે છે.
  4. Products surface છોડે છે જેથી removal ચાલુ રહે; transport limits uniformity બદલી શકે છે.
  5. Mask જળવાય તે રીતે time/endpoint અને directionality control કરીને required depth/profile મેળવાય છે.
  6. Approved stop/handling પછી pattern/release inspect થાય છે; fragile structuresમાં stiction/damage થઈ શકે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Etch rate, selectivity, uniformity, directionality, mask survival, endpoint useful geometry નક્કી કરે છે.
  • Undercut lateral dimensions બદલે છે; wet હંમેશાં isotropic/dry હંમેશાં perfectly directional નથી.

Applications / લાભ

Cavities, channels, membranes તથા release; selective removalથી functional shapes બને છે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Chemicals/plasma, mask loss, damage, stiction, compatibility limits; etchant/plasma settingsની recipe નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Deposition adds a film with required composition, thickness and properties instead of selectively removing the substrate.

Classification / representative type

  • Methods include PVD, CVD, electroplating and other suitable routes; their transport/reaction and equipment are not interchangeable.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Source/precursor or plating supply provides the material species appropriate to the method.
  2. Substrate holder establishes position and support during film growth.
  3. Controlled chamber/environment provides the required transport and cleanliness conditions.
  4. Power/thermal controls create evaporation, reaction or electrical deposition conditions as applicable.
  5. Method-specific flow, vacuum or electrical arrangements sustain the selected deposition route.
  6. Monitoring, extraction and inspection facilities control hazards and verify film quality.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Check substrate/material compatibility and prepare the surface by the approved process.
  2. Generate or supply depositing species using the selected method.
  3. Transport species to the substrate under controlled conditions.
  4. Species condense, react or deposit and nucleate/grow a film according to the actual mechanism.
  5. Control growth to obtain required thickness, composition, uniformity and coverage.
  6. Complete approved handling and inspect adhesion, stress, defects and interaction with previous layers.

Working parameters / controls

  • Deposition rate, temperature, pressure, composition, coverage, stress and contamination influence film performance.
  • High temperatures or poor adhesion can damage earlier layers; select the route with the entire process stack in mind.

Applications / advantages

Electrodes, insulators, structural and sacrificial films in MEMS; material addition builds functional layer stacks.

Limitations / safety

Poor step coverage, film stress, adhesion, contamination and hazardous environments limit use; no chemical/vacuum operating procedure.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Deposition substrate દૂર કરવાની બદલે required composition, thickness, propertiesવાળી film ઉમેરે છે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Methods PVD, CVD, electroplating વગેરે; transport/reaction તથા equipment interchangeable નથી.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Method મુજબ source/precursor અથવા plating supply depositing material species આપે છે.
  2. Substrate holder film growth દરમિયાન position તથા support જાળવે છે.
  3. Controlled chamber/environment required transport તથા cleanliness આપે છે.
  4. Method મુજબ power/thermal controls evaporation, reaction અથવા electrical depositionની conditions આપે છે.
  5. Method-specific flow, vacuum અથવા electrical arrangements selected routeને ચાલુ રાખે છે.
  6. Monitoring, extraction અને inspection hazards control કરે છે તથા film quality verify કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Substrate/material compatibility ચકાસીને approved processથી surface તૈયાર થાય છે.
  2. Selected method વડે depositing species generate અથવા supply કરવામાં આવે છે.
  3. Controlled conditionsમાં species substrate સુધી પહોંચાડવામાં આવે છે.
  4. Actual mechanism મુજબ species condense/react/deposit થઈ filmનું nucleation અને growth કરે છે.
  5. Required thickness, composition, uniformity તથા coverage માટે growth control થાય છે.
  6. Approved handling પછી adhesion, stress, defects તથા previous layers સાથેની compatibility તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Rate, temperature, pressure, composition, coverage, stress, contamination film performanceને અસર કરે છે.
  • High temperature/poor adhesionથી previous layers damage થઈ શકે છે;સંપૂર્ણ process stack મુજબ route પસંદ કરો.

Applications / લાભ

MEMS electrodes, insulators, structural/sacrificial films; material additionથી functional stacks બને છે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Coverage, stress, adhesion, contamination, hazardous environments limits; chemical/vacuum operating procedure નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A MEMS device converts a physical quantity into a useful signal or actuation through a designed transduction mechanism.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Accelerometer: proof-mass deflection changes a readout such as capacitance; used in motion/vehicle systems.
  • Pressure sensor: membrane deformation affects electrical readout; used in process/vehicle/medical systems where qualified.
  • Other examples: gyroscopes, microphones, microfluidic valves and optical micromirrors.
  • Complete chain: physical input→mechanical response→transduction→conditioning→calibration/output; packaging and environment affect real accuracy.
Are etching and deposition the same operation?

No. Etching removes exposed material; deposition adds a film. Lithography defines a pattern for subsequent processing.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

MEMS physical quantityને designed transductionથી useful signal/actuationમાં ફેરવે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Accelerometer proof-mass deflectionથી capacitance જેવા readout બદલે; motion/vehicles.
  • Pressure sensor membrane deformationથી readout; qualified process/vehicle/medical use.
  • Gyroscopes, microphones, microfluidic valves, optical micromirrors.
  • Chain physical input→mechanical response→transduction→conditioning→calibration/output; packaging/environment accuracy બદલે.
Etching અને Deposition સમાન Operation છે?

ના.Etching material દૂર કરે છે; deposition film ઉમેરે છે.Lithography આગળની processing માટે pattern નક્કી કરે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Investigate a documented component and selected process; an illustrative proposal is not an observed factory case.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Choose a component with a justified need: for example a conductive die cavity may motivate die-sinking EDM, subject to geometry and requirements.
  • Provide neat labelled sketch/drawing with dimensions/tolerance basis; cite the actual drawing/source or mark it illustrative.
  • Explain removal mechanism, classification, tool/work interaction and diagram; list actual component/tool/equipment materials.
  • Create a parameter table with symbol, unit, source and status: measured, manufacturer-specified or not available. Never fill missing values with guessed production settings.
  • For EDM collect current, pulse-on/off, gap/polarity, dielectric and flushing context if available; for another process use its relevant controls.
  • Compare advantages, limitations, geometry capability, surface integrity, tool wear, cost and safety/environment for the actual case.
  • Report evidence and uncertainty; separate cited industrial facts, student measurements and your recommendations.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Documented component/process તપાસો; illustrative proposalને observed factory case ન લખો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • જરૂરિયાત મુજબ component પસંદ; conductive die cavity માટે EDM વિચારાય,પણ geometry/requirements ચકાસો.
  • Labelled sketch/drawing, dimensions/tolerance basis આપો; actual source cite અથવા illustrative label.
  • Mechanism, classification, tool/work interaction, diagram સમજાવો; actual component/tool/equipment materials list કરો.
  • Parameter tableમાં symbol, unit, source, status measured/manufacturer/not available; guessed settingsથી missing values ન भरो.
  • EDMમાં available current, on/off, gap/polarity, dielectric, flushing;બીજા process માટે relevant controls.
  • Actual case માટે benefits, limits, geometry, surface integrity, wear, cost, safety/environment compare.
  • Evidence, uncertainty આપો; industrial facts, student readings, recommendations અલગ રાખો.

title.en: Die-sinking EDM:shaped electrode and controlled spark gap
Wire EDM:travelling wire through conductive work
LBM:focused optical energy and work path
Water jet:pressure energy becomes jet velocity
Selection:reject incompatible methods before comparing cost
Lithography:patterned exposure of resist,not substrate cutting
Etching:remove exposed material;directionality is a separate basis
Deposition:add a controlled film to a substrate

terms.en: Material, geometry, surface integrity and safety constrain every choice.
